system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

One of the Vesper Clans defining physical traits are their nails, black as midnight and able to be sharpened to rival the edge of a Kunai. The Clan has developed a special combat style utilizing their claws, or their claws in conjunction with a weapon from the Blade weapon group. While in combat you can sharpen and elongate your claws and enter your Claws of Night Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 1d8 and your [Unarmed Damage] type becomes Slashing.

Once per turn, when inflicting the Bruised condition, you can change it to be 1 rank of Bleed instead.

Once per turn, if you deal [Weapon Damage], with a weapon from the Blade weapon group that doesn’t have the Two-Handed property or [Unarmed Damage], you can force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save, gaining a rank of Crimson Hemorrhage on a failure.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.
